terms.comment: The Romans had no true chimneys.

phrases.latin: Camīnī sunt, per quōs fūmus ē culīnā exit
phrases.english: They’re chimneys, through which the smoke goes out of the kitchen
phrases.source: Libellus II, Sintra: castellum et puteus

sources: Lewis & Short: caminus · Lewis & Short: fumarium
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 122, 290.
Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word.
